name: Eric L. Chan
office: City of San Gabriel, Member of the City Council

items.text: Eric L. Chan is a member of the San Gabriel City Council and currently serves as the city’s rotating mayor. He was elected in 2022. He works as an accountant and property manager, and holds a degree in business economics and accounting from the University of California, Los Angeles. Before joining the council, he served nine years on the San Gabriel County Water District board. In a 2026 interview, he called public safety his top priority and said the city needs $50 million to upgrade its police station. He also supports business development and cultural inclusivity.
